programme.title: Blue World S8 - "Jojo the Dolphin"
programme.desc: Jonathan’s entire family travels to the Turks & Caicos Islands in search of a famous local celebrity—Jojo the friendly dolphin. Then Blue World explores a hidden cave—keeping an eye out for the alligators, for which it’s named!

programme.title: Blue World S8 - "Blue Hole Adventure in Belize"
programme.desc: Jonathan and Zach explore the reefs and famous Blue Hole of Belize, where they find an amazing number of animals including curious groupers, a friendly shark, a coral cave full of tiny fish, and spooky deep stalactites!

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "Time of the Grizzly"
programme.desc: The Grizzly Bear is funny and ferocious, a quivering coward and a daring hero, easily tamed yet forever wild. This disappearing giant is one of the most contradictory and complex of all our animal ideas.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "White on White"
programme.desc: On the Arctic tundra, predator and prey alike are aided by fur or feathers the color of snow. Some, like the Gyrfalcon and Snowy Owl, stay white year round. Others, like Ptarmigan and Snowshoe Hare, turn white for winter.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "The Wolf and the Whitetail"
programme.desc: In the wilderness, the seasons are everything. From Summer to Fall, from Winter to Spring, the lives of the wild animals are bound to the year long rhythm of life and death. For the survivors of Winter's harsh test, Spring is a time of renewal.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "Wolverine Country"
programme.desc: It's the mountainous home of a legendary creature: the Wolverine. It's been called a ravenous monster, a supernatural being, even 'skunk bear' thanks to its skunky aroma.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "Survival of the Fittest"
programme.desc: Animals adapt for survival. Crocodiles, ancient and resilient, boast slow metabolism and efficient physiology. Sharks retain successful traits over time. Whales, from land to sea, evolve with echolocation and robust anatomy, ensuring survival.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "The Big Cats"
programme.desc: Cheetahs race towards endangerment.Leopards thrive as opportunistic hunters.Lions reign atop the food chain. Snow leopards navigate treacherous terrain.Tigers persevere. Each big cat surviving maturity claims victory in life's relentless race.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "The Great Desert Race"
programme.desc: Deserts, harsh and arid, challenge life with scant rainfall. Desert animals adapt to conserve water, relying on food for hydration. They seek shade, burrow, or became nocturnal to survive extreme temperatures.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "Herbivores"
programme.desc: Elephants, thrive on vegetation, though they're not averse to confrontation. Rhinos, resilient yet endangered, face threats from predators and humanity. Hippos, formidable and protective, safeguard their young from crocodiles and other predators.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Noah's Ark for the Humans"
programme.desc: Scientists believe that within a few decades many useful microbes will have disappeared so they want to create a vault for Human Microbiota.

programme.title: Future Food S1 - "Episode 2"
programme.desc: Kanyan farmer and campaigner Moses Shaha is sceptical of biofuel. He journeys through southern Kenya, where farmers are starting to grow jatropha, to understand if the biofuel crop is a threat to farmland and food securuty as he fears.

programme.title: Future Food S1 - "Episode 3"
programme.desc: Exploring whether big agribusiness or small scale farmers are better placed to feed the world.

programme.title: Future Food S1 - "Episode 4"
programme.desc: In India, Tulika Verma is on a mission to ban junk food from Delhi's Schools, where one in six school children is overweight. India faces two possible futures: one healthy, and one a future of 'Western-style' diets and an epidemic of obesity.

programme.title: Future Food S1 - "Episode 5"
programme.desc: Nigerian Minister of Agriculture Akinwunmi Ayo Adesina believes it is his job to ensure Nigerians eat food grown in Nigeria, and he's determined to overcome the obstacles to Nigerian self-sufficiency in food production.

programme.title: Future Food S1 - "Episode 6"
programme.desc: Shanghai-based social media agency Resonance apply their branding skills to convince young Chinese that farming could be a viable career choice.

programme.title: Combat Dealers S4 - "French Resistance"

programme.title: Combat Dealers S4 - "WWI"
programme.desc: Bruce heads to Ypres looking for items from WWI, finding a German trench mortar. He also goes for a ride in a WWI-era British tank – one of the first tanks ever used in combat.

programme.title: Combat Dealers S4 - "Dunkirk"
programme.desc: Bruce finds a picture in his attic from Dunkirk, given to him by a soldier who was there. Bruce and Hus go on a hunt for kit that tells the real story of the evacuation.

programme.title: Combat Dealers S4 - "Battle Of The Bulge"
programme.desc: A client wants a German half-track armoured personnel carrier converted into a Pioneer variant, used by the German army during the Battle of the Bulge.

programme.title: Predict My Future: The Science of Us S1 - "The Early Years"

programme.title: Predict My Future: The Science of Us S1 - "When Teens Run Off The Rails"
programme.sub-title: When Teens Run Off The Rails
programme.desc: Based on the Dunedin Longitudinal Study results, this episode examines why most young adolescents engage in juvenile delinquency of some sort, minor and major.

programme.title: Predict My Future: The Science of Us S1 - "When Genes Mix With The Wrong Environment"
programme.sub-title: When Genes Mix With The Wrong Environment
programme.desc: The Dunedin Study has identified a fundamental developmental mechanism that completely rewrites the nature versus nurture argument

programme.title: Predict My Future: The Science of Us S1 - "Dirt Is Good, Dirt Poor Is Bad"

programme.desc: This episode of the series examines ways in which the results of the Dunedin study have contributed to a new understanding of early influences in a person's life

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Engineering Earth"
programme.desc: A heroic bid for freedom by an enslaved couple in 19th century America precipitates great innovation that culminates in people literally making heavens open. But can controlling the weather save us from climate catastrophe? Or are we playing god?

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Becoming Bionic"
programme.desc: From dissecting stolen corpses and peering into microscopes, the secret structure of the brain and nervous system is exposed. Could this lead to a race of superhumans?

programme.desc: Canberra is the youngest city to feature in our series; a mere “adolescent” in our rapidly urbanizing world. It stands out for all the right reasons as it affords those who live within its low-density realm a very privileged lifestyle indeed.
